performance.verdict: CPL is healthy but 0 GHL opps means leads aren't becoming cases yet.

findings.text: CPL fell 33.66% to $29.08 over 28 days with 62 Meta leads — efficiency is confirmed strong, but 0 GHL opportunities created means none have converted to pipeline.
⛔ Extension with Marwan unsigned as of 2026-08-31 (20 days overdue) — engagement is month-to-month lapsed; all media spend and SOW work are uncontracted.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since 2026-08-31 — contact-rate bottleneck (already flagged in July) has no CRM fix live to address it.
62 Meta leads reported vs 50 GHL contacts (12-lead gap, ~19%) and 0 opportunities — intake is leaking; this is a CRM/intake process problem, not an ads problem.

3-day lead signal (Sep 17–19: 3, 8, 6 = avg 5.7/day) vs prior 3 days (Sep 14–16: 7, 5, 5 = avg 5.7/day) — volume is holding flat at ~6/day after a strong re-launch; GBP actions dropped 88.89% last 7d (near-zero last 4 days), so organic is not contributing.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake leak: audit the 12 missing contacts and create opportunity records for all 50 existing GHL contacts immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta reported 62 leads over 28 days but only 50 contacts landed in GHL and 0 opportunities were created — a 12-lead gap (~19%) and a full pipeline stall. Andrew to audit the missing 12, confirm form-to-GHL webhook is firing correctly, and manually create opportunity records for all 50 existing contacts. Success = 0 gap between Meta leads and GHL contacts, and at least 50 opportunities created, confirmed by 2026-09-24.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta lead volume at current $74.80/day spend; hold budget until GHL pipeline confirms leads are converting to cases.
suggestions.monday_update: CPL is confirmed healthy at $29.08 and the 3-day signal shows ~5.7 leads/day, but 0 pipeline opportunities means scaling spend now would add unprocessed volume to a broken intake. Hold daily budget at ~$74.80 and re-evaluate scaling only after GHL opportunity creation is confirmed live. Re-check 2026-09-24 — if opportunities are populating and CPL holds below $35, bring a scale recommendation.

suggestions.text: Escalate ⛔ blockers to Sohib: extension signature, SMS automation, and Zoho Voice — all 20 days overdue.
suggestions.monday_update: Three SOW blockers are 20 days past their 2026-08-31 due dates: Marwan's extension signature (uncontracted spend at risk), SMS automation (contact-rate bottleneck unaddressed since July), and Zoho Voice access (intake team cannot call leads). Nacer to chase Joy and Andrew for Zoho Voice access and SMS config today; Sohib to re-engage Marwan on extension signature. Success = all three items resolved or formally escalated with a new date by 2026-09-24.
